responsibility: Implements pattern matching and replacement on SLP trees rather than on the original scalar SSA chain. It recognizes whole-node SLP idioms such as complex-number load/operation layouts and add-sub or fused multiply-add-sub patterns, validates target support through internal-function/optab checks, and rewrites matching SLP subtrees into pattern statements represented by vector internal functions, updating SLP representatives and metadata so later SLP scheduling and code generation operate on the transformed tree.
